items.explanation: Może + the my form of the perfective future makes a suggestion.
optionNotes: Do takes the genitive: do kina.
Past tense; a suggestion is about the future.

items.explanation: Ochota takes na + accusative: ochotę na kawę.
optionNotes: Do is for places: do kawiarni.
W does not go with ochota.

items.prompt: A friend invites you, but you are working. Decline politely.
items.explanation: Decline with niestety and a short reason after bo.
optionNotes: Correct but very cold; add a reason.
After bo use a full verb form: pracuję.
Pracuje is "he / she works"; I work is pracuję.

items.prompt: Gdzie ___ w piątek? (Where shall we meet on Friday?)
items.explanation: Meet up is spotkać się; się likes to stand early: Gdzie się spotkamy?
optionNotes: Spotkać alone means "run into"; meeting up needs się.
